Graduation

Although degrees are given at the end of each semester to qualifying students, a formal commencement ceremony is held at the end of the spring semester. Students who have more than two courses to complete for their degree requirements, or who have a cumulative grade point average below 2.00, will not be permitted to take part in the ceremony.

Students must apply for graduation by the deadline published for the fall semester or the spring semester in which they expect to finish. An application received after the deadline is held for the next term, and a student who does not complete the program requirements in that term must apply again.

Fall Semester

Applications are due by October 1.

Spring Semester

Applications are due by February 15.
